evidence.claim: TAL-9 covers authenticator-app one-time codes with enrolment via QR code, plus recovery codes and admin enforcement. That includes everything TAL-49 asks for (time-based codes, enrolment, code at sign-in). It is in progress.
TAL-49 asks for TOTP as a second sign-in step, with only two criteria: an enrolment flow and a code asked at sign-in.

body.why: TAL-49 is already covered by TAL-9, which is in progress. Both add authenticator-app one-time codes with enrolment and a code check at sign-in, and TAL-9 also covers recovery codes and admin enforcement. Call: Duplicate.
wouldChange: TAL-49 names work that TAL-9 does not cover, such as a different login surface or a non-authenticator-app method, which would make it Risky as a partial overlap.
TAL-9 is dropped or its scope is cut to exclude the sign-in code check, which would leave TAL-49 as Ready to Build.
